column1: # Three rows, three kinds of pin. Pin full commits, never branch names: a
# branch moves, and evidence about a moved branch is evidence about nothing.
# Keep this file and Docs/V1_OWNER_HANDOFF.md in step.
# The branch column is what makes a stale pin visible rather than something to
# remember: it names the branch (on origin, without the `origin/` prefix) whose
# tip the pin is meant to be. It cannot be inferred, because a pin sits on many
# branches. `v1-qualification.sh --check-pins` fetches and exits non-zero when
# any pin is not its branch's tip, and every run records the same check in each
# row's identity.txt and in SUMMARY.md.
# 1. `baseline`: main, the tree before any V1 change. It is the row the rc
# row's whole-suite failures and blocking gate rows are compared with, so it
# must stay a separate commit: comparing the candidate with itself would call
# nothing NEW. It runs every stage the rc row runs, Release included, so every
# stage has a baseline to be read against. It moves only if main does.
baseline
# 2. `rc`: the V1 candidate, and every check the per-PR rows used to run, at
# ONE commit. This line is the one place its pin lives: to repin, put
# `git rev-parse origin/claude/v1-reliability-nyngoe-rc` in the commit column
# and change the handoff's commit list to match. Merging anything into the
# candidate after this pin (#121 included) moves the branch past it, and
# --check-pins then says STALE until this line is repinned.
#   focused  the tests the handoff reads by name, with their own result bundle
#            and console log: PersonMentionTests (#117's entity-frame-comparison
#            lines and its skips), TemporalFullPathTests (#129's pass-level
#            test and F1's snoozed-series tests, where a skip is not a pass),
#            LocationReminderTests' #Predicate test (#135), and the one UI test
#            that reaches TodayView.needsReview (#140; UI tests are not in CI).
#            Every other class a per-PR row focused on is in the whole suite at
#            the same commit.
#   extra    Tools/CI/v1-probes.sh from this checkout: the December 24 family
#            and #151's sentences through the probe, #136's two scorers and
#            its R1 timing, and the typed inputs for the handoff's M3.
rc
# 3. `semantic-units`: the semantic-map lane's units experiment (#118, stacked
# on #117), at its own pin. That lane owns this row, its pin, its run.sh and its
# outputs; nothing here changes them.
semantic-units
